ModMetaData.name: Flora Tab
ModMetaData.author: Ordoxous
ModMetaData.description: Adds a Resources tab next to Wildlife with two pages. Plants lists the wild plants on the map you can harvest, such as berries, healroot and trees: how many there are, how many are ready, the yield you would get now, which are at risk, and how many are already marked. Minerals lists the ore you can see, such as steel, gold, plasteel and compacted machinery: how many cells and veins, the yield and its value, and how much sits under overhead mountain. Mark a whole kind in one click, or jump to the next one on the map.
